However, in modern usage, especially among the Bengali community, it is used as a term of endearment. The name has lost its original meaning and now signifies someone who is dear, lovable, or beloved. It is important to note that the use of the name "Papu" may also depend on regional variations and dialects.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Papu" may represent the Divine who loves us unconditionally, no matter our faults or mistakes. It may serve as a reminder that love and compassion transcend the mundane aspects of life, like errors or sins. The name may also symbolize the potential within each person to transform their flaws and mistakes into strengths and virtues, much like how a seed becomes a tree, transforming a small germ into a massive tree.
